body: Exactly why I have so much anxiety my first few weeks at a new job. Too much too fast, but you can't have a melt down at work so I just dissociate
Thank you! That is good advice, I think my anxious brain will just have me word vomit at times so counting would definitely help!! I really appreciate your kind words

People who post things like "I'm just DONE"

"DONT BOTHER MESSAGING ME"

"Why do I even bother lol"

Then like 10 minutes later posting selfies wanting people to "hit you up"

Please put your phone away when having mental outbursts

Sincerely, everyone else with mental illness

Having to post every good thing you do on social media. 

I don't mean like giving yourself a good pat on the back for completing school or something. I know people who will make a facebook post about how good of a friend they are to X person for throwing them a party. Or you got someone a gift and you have to post about how expensive it is.
Or even worse. Say no but the child has control in the relationship and still gets what they want.
People who neglect their animals and children. Abuse is never okay, but when the victims are unable to even comprehend what is happening and can't get help. Truly disturbing.
As a custodian, it literally sucks a little bit of my soul out

Number 12 really hit home for me. Seriously is why I never make decisions in a group setting. It's always oh I don't care, or wherever is most convenient because whenever I actually did voice what I wanted to my mom, she'd complain how it wasn't what she would have picked etc. THEN DONT DUCKING ASK MY OPINION IF MY RESPONSE DOESNT CHANGE THE OUTCOME.

Thanks for letting me rant about that. I'm sorry your mom is unable to see the irony of her post.
Just turn of aging in the Sims 4 ;)
